sources.snippet: DINOv2 scales self-supervised ViT pretraining for strong transferable visual features without labels. These checkpoints are backbones that return patch tokens for downstream heads. For more details on the model, please go to the upstream model card. Pure- Keras 3 conversion of facebook/dinov2-small for kerasformers.

sources.title: dinov2-small by facebook, Image Feature Extraction | Mixpeek Model Hub
sources.snippet: On Mixpeek, dinov2-small runs as a managed extractor inside a processing pipeline. Point a bucket of image feature extraction data at it, and Mixpeek handles GPU provisioning, batching, retries, and writing the outputs into a vector store you can query.
